title: Badge artifact — /badge/{node_id}.json (shields.io endpoint response)
description:
The badge body a README embeds, in the shields.io ENDPOINT schema. Two rules govern it and both are about honesty rather than looks.

(1) A STALE BADGE MUST NEVER KEEP ASSERTING REGISTRATION (WEB-085). `suspended`, `quit` and `delisted` repositories all render the neutral form — label unchanged, message 'status: see registry', colour lightgrey — and the edge route serves the neutral form even against a still-cached artifact whenever the index meta's delist set contradicts it (FS10-032). An unknown node_id answers 200 with `isError: true` and 'not registered', because shields renders errors from bodies, not from 404s (FS10-033).

(2) NO MONEY FIGURE BEFORE THE LEDGER. The default message is mechanism copy ('registered'); a charity band may render only after the first franc actually moves, and the band thresholds and visual design are an open decision (URS §21 OPEN-11, VS-24, MKT-042).

SCHEMA-VERSION NOTE: `schemaVersion` here is shields.io's own literal `1`, which happens to satisfy the FS-00 §6.2 requirement that every artifact carry a schema version. This artifact deliberately carries NO `generatedAt` field: the body must remain a valid shields endpoint response, so freshness travels in the `ETag` and `Last-Modified` headers instead (FS10-003).

schemaVersion.description: shields.io endpoint schema version. Must be the literal 1.

label.description: Fixed left-hand text. Constant across every state so a reader's eye tracks the right-hand message, and so a neutral badge is visibly the SAME badge rather than a different one.

message.description: Right-hand text. Canonical values: `registered` (verified), `status: see registry` (suspended/quit/delisted), `not registered` (unknown id). A money band may appear only post-first-franc (OPEN-11).

isError.description: True only for the unknown-node_id response, which is still served with HTTP 200 (FS10-033).

cacheSeconds.description: Shields' own cache hint. Kept consistent with the edge cache policy: s-maxage 3600, stale-while-revalidate 24 h, stale-if-error 7 days (FS10-033, INF-15).
